_about: Preseason availability and form, applied at build time. yourGp = games you expect the player to play this season (Minutes & Health 'Your GP'). adj = ADJ boost mark ('+ + +' .. '- - -', multiplies production). Estimates from preseason reporting. Update as news changes and rerun build.py.
markersLegend: ADJ marks: + + + / + + / + boost production; - / - - / - - - cut it. Applies to NBA players only.
